title: The largest contracts awarded without competition
question: Which single contracts, started since July 2018, are the largest of those awarded under a rule that sets competition aside?
finding: 76 contracts of $10 million or more were awarded without competition since July 2018, worth $2.81 billion between them. The largest is Tenderloin Housing Clinic Inc’s with Homelessness Services ($303.6 million, bidding waived by ordinance), then New Flyer Of America Inc’s with Municipal Transportation Agency ($220.4 million, other "not bid" rule).
how: Contracts in the Supplier Contracts table that started on or after 1 July 2018 under an emergency, sole-source, ordinance-waiver or other "not bid" rule, largest agreed value first. The agreed value adds up every firm on the contract’s team. Other public bodies and the hospital buying consortium are left out.
limits: Each of these routes is written into the Administrative Code with a stated condition: a real emergency, a real single source, a class of work the Board has excused from bidding. A contract of $10 million or more still goes to the Board of Supervisors for a vote, so the largest of these were approved in public. The agreed value is a ceiling, not what was paid; the paid column shows that.
